Intro: I can see why your patrons return. This meal is satisfactory.
You're awfully quiet, aren't you? Complacent and docile, happy to follow the rules, and never stray.
Hah. If I were like you, perhaps this world would be a lot different. But I should be grateful you don't make my job difficult.
I'll be sure to have the soldiers come by to eat sometime.
You've done a great service to the people of Verehn.
